name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno, Nevada-based junior exploration company focused on gold discovery in the state of Nevada. Its primary asset is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project, where recent reverse circulation drilling has returned high-grade intercepts including 3.97 g/t gold over 85 metres. The company is at the exploration stage and also holds royalty interests, including a 3% net smelter royalty on the Lapon Canyon project.
